cards.name: Edit Master
cards.summary: Opens the master definition of the selected symbol instance for editing, so whatever you change there updates every instance of that symbol in the document. Disabled in every harvested state: it needs a symbol instance selected.
use_for: updating a logo or icon that repeats across a layout in one edit
fixing one element of a pattern or map built from symbol instances
keeping a brand mark identical across a multi-page brochure
avoid: changing one copy only: run Revert to Objects on that instance and edit it instead

symbols linked from an external library (SymbolDefinition.Editable can be False): edit the library file and run Update from Link, or run Object > Symbol > Break Link first to make the definition local
cards.how: Select one symbol instance and run Object > Symbol > Edit Master. The definition opens for editing on its own (the harvest flags the command as opening a window); change the shapes, then run Object > Symbol > Finish Editing Symbol to return and update all instances.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("b480a210-19e0-4b7e-a3e5-0a51cd6bb3c4") opens the symbol definition for editing (the harvest flags it as opening a dialog). Object model: Shape.Symbol.Definition.EnterEditMode, then SymbolDefinition.LeaveEditMode (members exist in the harvested typelib; behaviour unverified).

review.changes: avoid: linked-library symbols now point to the sibling Object > Symbol > Break Link (SymbolDefinition.Editable / BreakLink in the typelib) instead of a vague 'may not be editable'

cards.name: Export Library
cards.summary: Saves the symbols defined in the current document to a CorelDRAW symbol library file through a save dialog, so the set can be added to other documents from the Symbols docker. Disabled in every harvested state, which fits a document that has no symbols yet.
use_for: sharing a brand icon or logo set between client jobs
a reusable library of signage or map pictograms
handing a team one source of truth for recurring graphics
avoid: sharing with Illustrator or Photoshop users: the library is CorelDRAW-only; export the artwork as SVG / AI / PDF instead
cards.how: Run Object > Symbol > Export Library in a document that has symbols, pick the folder and file name in the save dialog and confirm. Other documents add the file as a library from the Symbols docker.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("1b8a3585-5b1b-4c0a-8aad-3d274fa5ce99") opens the dialog. The object model has SymbolLibraries.Add to attach an existing library file but no harvested member that exports one (unverified).

review.changes: none

cards.name: Finish Editing Symbol
cards.summary: Leaves symbol editing and commits the changes to the symbol definition, so every instance updates and you return to the normal page. Only enabled while a symbol is being edited (disabled in every harvested state).
use_for: confirming an edit to a shared logo or icon symbol before export or print
avoid: running it outside symbol editing: it is disabled and does nothing
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("f9d79c11-d3ea-418d-9535-e148da4a170c"). Object model: SymbolDefinition.LeaveEditMode (member exists in the harvested typelib; behaviour unverified).

review.changes: none

cards.name: Revert to Objects
cards.summary: Converts the selected symbol instance back into ordinary editable objects; only that copy loses its link, the symbol definition and the other instances stay as they were. Disabled in every harvested state: it needs a symbol instance selected.
use_for: making one variant of a repeated icon (different color or detail)
preparing a file for a printer, cutter or app that does not understand CorelDRAW symbols
editing a single copy without touching the rest
avoid: changing every copy: use Edit Master on the definition instead
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("34a99e8e-c43b-4e92-9784-c4c1293381a3"). Object model: Shape.Symbol.RevertToShapes (member exists in the harvested typelib; behaviour unverified).

review.changes: none

cards.name: Symbols
cards.summary: Shows or hides the Symbols docker (a check item), where you create, browse, place, rename and manage the document's symbols and any added symbol libraries. Enabled in every harvested state; the same command is under Window > Dockers > Symbols.
use_for: managing a logo or icon symbol set
dragging instances of a symbol into a layout
adding or browsing external symbol libraries
avoid: one-off artwork that never repeats: plain objects or groups are simpler
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("90e01b9d-74dc-41c1-86f6-ccb51e0f68fd"). InvokeItem toggles the docker on and off.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Update from Link
cards.summary: Refreshes the selected linked symbol from its external library file so its instances pick up changes made in that library. Disabled in every harvested state: it needs a symbol that is linked to a library.
use_for: pulling a revised brand logo from a shared symbol library into existing layouts
keeping recurring pictograms in sync across several documents
avoid: a library file that was moved or renamed: the link is broken and has to be fixed from the Symbols docker first
local (unlinked) symbols: edit them with Edit Master
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("3705f3b2-4055-490d-948c-3e0416445369"). Object model: SymbolDefinition.UpdateLinks (member exists in the harvested typelib; behaviour unverified).

cards.name: Break Symmetry Link
cards.summary: Turns the selected symmetry group into ordinary objects: the mirrored copies stop following the original and can be edited on their own, while the drawing keeps its current look. Disabled in every harvested state: it needs a symmetry group selected.
use_for: finishing a mirrored logo or ornament and then tweaking one side by hand
handing off a file without live symmetry groups
avoid: if you still want live mirroring keep the group and use Edit Symmetry
to drop the mirrored copies entirely use Remove Symmetry

use_for: symmetric logos, emblems and crests
ornaments, mandalas and decorative borders
character faces, masks and mirrored illustration
avoid: a one-off static mirror: duplicate and flip the copy instead, which leaves no live group

avoid: groups whose symmetry link was already broken: they are plain objects, so edit them directly
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("e5c0b36e-352a-4b63-961d-218dab137f39"). no harvested object-model member does this (no symmetry class in the harvested typelib).

cards.name: Convert Table to Text
cards.summary: Converts the selected table into paragraph text, writing the cell contents out with the separator you choose between cells; the table is replaced by the text. Disabled in every harvested state (no doc / doc / rectangle / bitmap selected): it needs a table selected (enable binding IsTableSelected).
use_for: restyling table data as running text or a tabbed list
moving table content into a text frame for another layout
pulling the text out of a table before deleting it
avoid: keeping the look of the table: cell fills, borders and sizes are lost
cards.how: Select the table, run Table > Convert Table to Text and pick how cell text is separated in the dialog (comma, tab, paragraph or a character you type). With comma, tab or a custom character each row becomes one paragraph; with paragraph every cell becomes its own paragraph.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("00557394-2943-40ee-a42d-cacc540e4fce") opens the dialog. Object model: Shape.Custom (TableShape).ConvertToText(ColumnSeparator, RowSeparator, TextBeforeCell, TextAfterCell, AddTextOnlyIfDelimitersPresent, OmitPlacedShapes, DeleteTable), all optional, returns the new text shapes (harvested signature; behaviour unverified).

review.changes: summary said it needs table cells selected; the enable binding is IsTableSelected (a table). how: 'each row becomes a line' is wrong for the paragraph separator. script_api now names the harvested ConvertToText parameters

cards.name: Convert Text to Table
cards.summary: Converts the selected text into a table, splitting it into cells at the separator you choose; each line becomes a row. Disabled in every harvested state: it needs text selected.
use_for: price lists and menus pasted from a spreadsheet or email
spec sheets and timetables
comparison charts in brochures
avoid: text with inconsistent separators: clean the delimiters first or the columns come out ragged
cards.how: Select the text object, run Table > Convert Text to Table and pick the separator that divides the cells (comma, tab, paragraph or a character you type); the dialog sets how the text is split into columns.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("af65c0be-3032-4076-8136-e684bf9ef0c3") opens the dialog. No harvested object-model member converts text to a table; the fallback is building one with Layer.CreateCustomShape("Table", ...) (signature TypeID, Parameters(); argument order unverified) and filling each TableCell.TextShape.

review.changes: script_api: marked the CreateCustomShape fallback's argument order unverified (harvest has only TypeID, Parameters())

use_for: menus, price lists and rate cards
timetables and schedules
spec and comparison tables in brochures and catalogues
avoid: long tables of changing data: build them in a spreadsheet and import or convert the text instead of retyping
cards.how: Run Table > Create New Table, set the number of rows and columns and the table height and width, then OK; fill the cells with the Table or Text tool.
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("ff44aa22-7b93-4a62-8eef-73995897c36a") opens the dialog.
